# mergegateway_models (Data Source)

Lists the catalog models the organization can route to, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every model that takes images and has at least a 128k context window.
data "mergegateway_models" "vision" {
  input_modality     = "image"
  min_context_length = 128000
}

output "vision_models" {
  value = [for m in data.mergegateway_models.vision.models : m.id if m.status == "available"]
}

# Models that are scheduled to retire, and what to move to.
output "retiring_models" {
  value = {
    for m in data.mergegateway_models.vision.models : m.id => m.replacement_model
    if m.expiration_date != null
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `input_modality` (String) Only models that accept this input, such as `image`.
- `min_context_length` (Number) Only models whose context window is at least this many tokens.
- `output_modality` (String) Only models that return this output, such as `audio`.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) The models, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `context_window` (Number) The maximum input context, in tokens.
- `display_name` (String) The model's name for display.
- `expiration_date` (String) The day the model is retired (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when no date is set.
- `id` (String) The model's `provider/model` ID, the value to send as `model` in a request.
- `input_cost_per_million` (Number) The list price per million input tokens, in USD.
- `input_modalities` (Set of String) What the model accepts, such as `text` and `image`.
- `max_output_tokens` (Number) The most tokens a response can have.
- `model_provider` (String) The model's creator, such as `openai`. (Terraform reserves the name `provider`.)
- `output_cost_per_million` (Number) The list price per million output tokens, in USD.
- `output_modalities` (Set of String) What the model returns.
- `replacement_model` (String) The model to move to once this one is retired.
- `status` (String) `available`, `beta` or `deprecated`.
